title: Cut the Support
setup: Your bishop on g2 stares at the bishop on d5, which survives only because the knight on e7 guards it.
hint: Two bishops face off on the long diagonal. One black piece decides that duel — can you get at it?
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Bxe7}} removes the only defender of d5. After {{Qxe7}} the bishop is undefended and {{Bxd5}} wins a clean piece. The trade on e7 is even; the piece it uncovers is not. A duel on a diagonal is decided by whoever supports the pieces.
